title: Unit – 2 : Session – 1 : SLO – 2  |  Inserting an Element into an Array
sections: Step 1: Set upper_bound = N + 1  (the array grows by one; new upper bound)
Step 2: Set A[N + 1] = VAL  (place the value at the new last position)
II. Pseudocode — Insert VAL at position POS
Step 2: Repeat Steps 3 and 4 while I >= POS
Step 3: SET A[I + 1] = A[I]   (shift element right)
Note: shifting starts from the last element downward so no element is overwritten before being copied.
